description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different categories of knowledge as perceived by various language models. The horizontal axis represents the categories, which include Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis indicates the popularity, measured on a scale from 0 to 220. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different language model: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). Additionally, there are four types of knowledge represented by different patterns on the bars: Acc=0 & GT Ans (solid blue), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (dotted blue), Acc=1 & GT Ans (solid red), and Acc=1 & Gene Ans (dotted red). The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized. The chart does not provide any annotations or additional information beyond the visual representation of the data.
